name: Aneimo ~Ai to H no Step Up~
original_name: あねいも～アイとHのステップアップ～
source:
The main character is Tohno Kazuya, a senior in high school who lives at home with two girls his family took in ten years ago. One is slightly older than he, named Manami, while the other is slightly younger than he, named Madoka. The three, for all intents and purposes, live by themselves in a rather spacious house in the suburbs, since Kazuya's father works abroad and his mother is deceased. The setting is in the middle of summer break, beginning in June and ending in August, and the premise of our story is the budding...attraction between Kazuya and either Manami or Madoka.

[From [url=https://moroboshiyuumei.livejournal.com/9512.html]moroboshiyuumei review[/url]]
translation:
主角遠野和也是一名高三學生，與十年前被家裡收養的兩名少女共同生活。愛美比他稍長，圓則比他小一點。和也的父親在國外工作，母親已經去世，因此三人就這樣三個人住在郊區一棟寬敞的房子裡。故事發生在暑假期間，從六月持續到八月，描寫和也與愛美或圓之間悄然萌芽的感情……

[摘自[url=https://moroboshiyuumei.livejournal.com/9512.html]moroboshiyuumei的評論[/url]]
